title: 2026 Trotter Prize and Lecture Series [Date TBD]
description: The Trotter Prize in Information, Complexity and Inference is awarded annually for pioneering contributions to understanding the role of information, complexity and inference in illuminating the mechanisms and wonder of nature. The Trotter Lecture seeks to reveal connections between science and religion, often viewed in academia as non-overlapping, if not rival, worldviews. The 2026 honorees will be announced closer to the event.
